review.reason: The course layout, greens, water, and striped fairways are generally faithful, but added trees visibly cover Hole 3’s fairway and approach area.

issues.detail: Several tree crowns overlap the striped Hole 3 fairway and its route toward G3, especially along the lower-middle portion of the course. Keep the fairway and approach clear of added vegetation.
issues.consequence: The trees obscure the mapped fairway footprint and make Hole 3’s intended route to its green harder to read in the overview.
